steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Read the documentation Start with the LazyOtter docs , whose welcome page explains what the community and its products are about.
2 Step 2 : Open the app Use the Launch App button on the LazyOtter homepage , which leads to the LazyOtter app .
3 Step 3 : Follow the step-by-step guides The docs offer Step-by-Step Guides for setting up the product.
4 Step 4 : Look at the risk tools Read the Risk Evaluation and Yield index pages to see what each tool covers before using it.
